name: Lai
source:
"I want to be the one who lights up your eyes like that. I don't want to see you fall back into the shadows again."

A private detective who assists Yvet. He was a police detective whose life was saved by Yvet. He's suspicious of the Ghost, who keeps some secrets from Yvet.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
